content: Amoone Bolla Yootettida Tinbite
GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,
«Haysso asa nawu! Ne sinth Amoone biittaako zaarada istta bolla tinbite yoota.
Isttas, ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAA qaala siyite; Ubbaa Haariza GODAY ta Keeththay tunida wode, Isra7eele biittay bulattida wode, Yuhuda asay di7etti bida wode, intte isttas hashshu! gida gishshas,
arshey mokkiza baggara diza derezas intte haarettana mala ta inttena aaththa immana. Isttika intte giddon bantta dunkaane tokkidi daana; intte miththata ayfe maana; intte maaththika istti uyana.
Tani Eraaba katama gaamellati heemettizaso, Amoone dorsatikka heemettizaso kessana; tani GODAA gididayssa intte he wode erana› ga yoota.
Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Intte wozina iitateththaa gaason Isra7eele kundeththaan intte ufayettidi kushe baqqida gishshassinne guppi kaa7idanne qidhida gishshas,

tani ta qese intte bolla denththana; tani kawoteththati inttefe bonqqana mala ooththana; ta inttena kawoteththata giddofe shoddana; asaappeka shaakkada dhayssana; ta inttena dippi histtana. Tani GODAA gididayssa intte he wode erana› gees.
Mo7aabe Bolla Yootettida Tinbite
«Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Mo7aabeynne Seyrey: be7ite, Yuhuda asay hara kawoteththata mala gidides gida gishshas,
istta biitta zawa bolla dizaytanne izis bonchcho gidida katamata Beeti-Yashimooteppe, Ba7aali-Me7ooneppenne Qiriyaataymeppe doommada Mo7aabe miixa qaara yeggana.
Mo7aabetinne Amooneti isttas haarettana mala ta istta arshey wulliza baggara diza deraas aaththa immana; Amoone asaas hayssafe guye kawoteththata matan istta qofsiza miishshi deenna.
Tani Mo7aabe qaxxayana; tani GODAA gididayssa istti he wode erana› gees.
Eedoome Bolla Yootettida Tinbite
«Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Eedoomey Yuhuda bolla halo kessida gishshassinne hessan mooranchcha gidida gishshas,
Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: tani ta qese Eedoome bolla denththana. Iza asaanne mehaa ta wodhana; ta iza bula histtana; Temaaneppe biidi Dadaane gakkanaas istti mashshan wurana.
Ta dere Isra7eele denththada Eedoome bolla halo kessana; isttika ta hanqo malanne ta bosha mala Eedoome deraa bolla ooththana; tani halo kessidayssa istti he wode erana› gees.
Filisxeeme Bolla Yootettida Tinbite
«Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Filisxeemeti wozina iitateththan dendidi halo kessida gishshassinne Yuhudakka kase gam7ida morkketeththan kadhidi dhayssanaassa.
Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: tani ta qese Filisxeeme asaa bolla denththana; Kelite asaa qanxxana; abba gaxan attidaytakka dhayssana.
Tani istta bolla wolqqama halo kessana; ta boshankka istta qaxxayana; ta istta qaxxayiza wode istti tani GODAA gididayssa erana› gees» gides.
